name: zvideo_frustum_test_sphere_clip_mask
description: zVideo_FrustumTestSphereClipMask tests a sphere against the active view frustum planes, returning reject bits and accumulating clip bits.
known_limits: Binary Ninja keeps a limited reconstruction marker because repeated x87 dot-product comparisons still render as status-word flag checks in HLIL.
No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this zVideo helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVideo source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x478c70 validates old-mask capture, clip-mask reset, near-plane and far-plane center deltas, side-plane camera-position delta, reject return bits, and accumulated clip bits.
The native zVideo frustum smoke verifies near, side, and far reject/clip/clear cases against a controlled active view context.
